subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the deepest part of the cave

730370201.text: #Now that we have destroyed Marana's Avatar, peace should be restored in the forest. Well, I said "we," but it was mostly due to your efforts and courage. Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}.

730370203.text: They gave me the courage to keep going.

730370207.text: Each flower is connected with the heart of an Aranara. One could even say that a garland of these flowers woven together can form the door to "Mahavana{RUBY#[S]the Aranara universe}ranapna."

730370208.text: As long as it connects us, we can support you when you are in need, lend you strength to conquer nightmares, help you through dark days, and fill the void in your heart.

730370209.text: There are those who no longer dream and thus can no longer see us, those who have accepted fate and stopped searching for the way forward, and those who wallow in fear and pain. Their hearts have hardened, unable to get help from these flowers.

730370210.text: #It's because Nara {NICKNAME} is kind and honest, and because Nara {NICKNAME} is Nara {NICKNAME}, that the garland could serve its purpose.

730370211.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is Aranara's friend. We won't leave our friend alone to fight Marana and eliminate all evil for a brighter and purer world.

730370212.text: #Well, {NICKNAME} is Paimon's best friend, so of course {F#she's}{M#he's} the best person ever! Anyway, Paimon guesses this Withering business has been settled once and for all then, right?

730370213.text: Marana should fall into slumber now that its avatar has been destroyed. But in a matter of decades, perhaps centuries, it will wake up again.

730370214.text: It's because Marana's memory has been left in Sarva. Unless that can be completely removed, the memory of "death" that dwells in all things will eventually bring it back again.

730370215.text: #...But this will take a long time. I believe that by then there will once again come someone as golden as the sun, just like Nara {NICKNAME} and Nara Varuna, so I wouldn't worry about it.

730370216.text: Today's forest has a bright future ahead. As long as what remains of Marana is cleared, the children of the forest will be able to enjoy abundant sunshine and rain.

730370217.text: Well... Anyway, now that Marana's Avatar is destroyed, the next step is to plant a new Ashvattha Tree for the Bija, right?

730370218.text: Yes. Please wait here for a moment while I fetch Arana.

730370219.text: Arana... Right, we've gotta use Arana's memories to produce the Bija...

730370220.text: But isn't Arana around Vimara Village? How are we gonna...

730370223.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Arana sensed your battle against Marana's Avatar. You and Arama are very brave.

730370206.text: #That was a close call... Thankfully, {NICKNAME} was wearing that garland! It's even more amazing than Paimon thought!

730370102.text: This is where the last war ended. We... They crushed Marana's Avatar and imprisoned it here with the four seals.

730370103.text: Looks scary... So is Marana's Avatar in there?

730370104.text: Marana has corroded the Vasara Tree that was meant to grow atop it and has gained possession of its bodily form. If left unchecked, it'll eventually eat away at all life on this earth.

730370105.text: Since it's not at its full strength yet, now would be the best time to destroy its avatar. With it defeated, we should be able to obtain the Bija.

730370106.text: #Come, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, let's get going.

730370402.text: We finally got it. The precious Bija...

730370404.text: Yeah. Now all we need to do is to give it to Rana, right?

730370501.text: #Now that we have destroyed Marana's Avatar, peace should be restored in the forest. Well, I said "we," but it was mostly due to your efforts and courage. Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}.

730370503.text: They gave me the courage to keep going.

730370507.text: Each flower is connected with the heart of an Aranara. One could even say that a garland of these flowers woven together can form the door to "Mahavana{RUBY#[S]the Aranara universe}ranapna."

730370508.text: As long as it connects us, we can support you when you are in need, lend you strength to conquer nightmares, help you through dark days, and fill the void in your heart.

730370509.text: There are those who no longer dream and thus can no longer see us, those who have accepted fate and stopped searching for the way forward, and those who wallow in fear and pain. Their hearts have hardened, unable to get help from these flowers.

730370510.text: #It's because Nara {NICKNAME} is kind and honest, and because Nara {NICKNAME} is Nara {NICKNAME}, that the garland could serve its purpose.

730370511.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is Aranara's friend. We won't leave our friend alone to fight Marana and eliminate all evil for a brighter and purer world.

730370512.text: #Well, {NICKNAME} is Paimon's best friend, so of course {F#she's}{M#he's} the best person ever! Anyway, Tighnari also said there'll be no new Withering Zones! Paimon guesses this Withering business has finally been settled once and for all then, right?

730370513.text: Yes. May we never meet again, Marana. Many tiny Marana remain in the forest, but we've defeated the greatest one.

730370514.text: I can sense that all memories about Marana in Sarva have been completely erased. In this case, even the memory and fear of "death" that dwells in all things cannot bring it back ever again.

730370515.text: #There are still many things in the world that covet life. But I believe that there will always be someone as golden as the sun, just like Nara {NICKNAME} and Nara Varuna, so I wouldn't worry about it.

730370516.text: Today's forest has a bright future ahead. As long as what remains of Marana is cleared, the children of the forest will be able to enjoy abundant sunshine and rain.

730370517.text: Well... Anyway, now that Marana's Avatar is destroyed, the next step is to plant a new Ashvattha Tree for the Bija, right?

730370518.text: Yes. Please wait here for a moment while I fetch Arana.

730370519.text: Arana... Right, we've gotta use Arana's memories to produce the Bija...

730370520.text: But isn't Arana around Vimara Village? How are we gonna...

730370523.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Arana sensed your battle against Marana's Avatar. You and Arama are very brave.

730370506.text: #That was a close call... Thankfully, {NICKNAME} was wearing that garland! It's even more amazing than Paimon thought!

730370302.text: Arama has grown into the new Ashvattha Tree. It's small now, but the roots are deep and strong. After many, many moons, it will surely grow to be big and beautiful.

730370303.text: Arana, you once said that memories and dreams are Aranara's source of strength. If you give those memories up, you'll forget Rana, won't you? And the children of Vimara Village too...

730370304.text: Yes. But friends are more precious than memories. You can always make up for lost memories, but not a lost friend.

730370305.text: I want to help Narana. She has the same name as Arana. She is Arana's friend.

730370306.text: And even if Arana doesn't remember, you will. As long as you remember, your memory will one day grow into a ripe and robust fruit...

730370309.text: #Arana has taught you the Rhythm of the Great Dream. Do you still remember it, Nara {NICKNAME}?

730370310.text: Just play this song to Arana and Arama.

subQuests.subQuestName: Play the Rhythm of the Great Dream

730370801.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, please make it quick. The Ararakalari that Arana left with Narana won't last long.
